_comment: Which 3D characters are built with the skinned body (tools/blender/stagekit/body3d.py): one continuous surface from the neck down, bound to the joints, with the clothes made from that surface. Everyone else keeps the classic body. CAST_BODY=skinned or CAST_BODY=classic in the environment overrides this list for the whole cast. "sculpt" gives a character a sculpted body from library/bodies (made with tools/chars3d/bake_body.py) instead of a built one; a sheet may also say "body_model": "<name>" itself.
